title: Daily Routines and Habits
summary: Practice talking about your morning and evening routines using simple present tense and frequency adverbs.

activities.title: Morning Routine Check-in
activities.instructions: Pair up and describe three things you do every morning before 9 AM.
activities.content: Secret prompt: Discuss how coffee or tea changes your mood in the morning.

activities.title: Scheduling a Weekend Activity
activities.instructions: In pairs, plan a Saturday schedule that includes brunch, exercise, and reading.
activities.content: Gated scenario instructions for facilitators: Ensure students use 'always', 'sometimes', and 'never'.

vocabulary.example: My daily commute takes thirty minutes by bus.
Having a healthy morning routine helps me start the day well.
